hpke.note: Encapsulation is deterministic here: the ML-KEM-768 ciphertext comes from mlkemEncapsulationSeed and the X25519 ephemeral from ephemeralX25519Secret, so every value below is re-derivable from the inputs alone. xwingCombinerSharedSecret is what the X-Wing combiner would produce over the same components; it is recorded only to make the divergence checkable, never as X-Wing conformance.

kemDerive.note: suite.kem_derive(ikm) -> (secretKey, publicKey). secretKey is ML-KEM-768 dk (2400) || X25519 sk (32); publicKey is ML-KEM-768 ek (1184) || X25519 pk (32). dkpPrk is the HPKE labeled extract this repository recomputes independently.
